fields.name: key_id
fields.help: key_id from your noon service-account key file (.json), created in the noon Partner portal.

fields.name: private_key
fields.help: private_key (PEM) from the same service-account key file; it signs the RS256 login JWT.

config_fields.name: project_code
config_fields.help: project_code from the key file, sent as default_project_code at login.

config_fields.name: warehouse_code
config_fields.help: Integration warehouse code for stock updates and FBPI order listing (see ListWarehouses).

config_fields.name: country_code
config_fields.help: Marketplace country code for pricing (e.g. ae, sa, eg).

me.note: Logs in with the RS256 service-account JWT (session cookies) and returns user_code and username.

update_listing.note: BatchUpsertPricing for one partner SKU (listing_id) in the configured country_code: sets the price. Only `price` is applied — quantities go through set_inventory and titles/descriptions through the Content API (brand, category and attributes required). The per-item result is in result_code/message.

end_listing.note: BatchUpsertPricing with is_active false for the partner SKU (listing_id) in the configured country_code: deactivates the offer there.

set_inventory.note: UpdateStock {items: [{warehouse_code, partner_sku, qty}]} for the configured warehouse_code; `sku` is the partner SKU. The per-item result is in result_code/message.

list_orders.note: ListFbpiOrders for the configured warehouse_code (Fulfilled By Partner orders, up to 50 per page), created after `since` when given; pass next_cursor back as `cursor` (the next_token query parameter). Item statuses (mp_status, integration_status) are under items. `status` is not applied.

not_offered.create_listing: UpsertProduct requires 'brand (string, required)', 'category (string, required)', 'images' and an 'attributes (object map, required)' per category (https://noon-docs.noonpartners.dev/docs/api-reference/content/content-service-upsert-product); the vocabulary's create_listing has no brand, category or attributes.
not_offered.mark_shipped: CreateShipment needs 'integration_shipment_nr (string, required)' and 'items (object[], required)' with each 'mp_item_nr' of the order (https://noon-docs.noonpartners.dev/docs/api-reference/fbpi/fbpi-service-create-shipment); mark_shipped carries only order_id, carrier and tracking_number.

adapter.terms: noon Partner API (https://noon-docs.noonpartners.dev/docs/authentication/authenticating-requests): a service-account key file (key_id + RSA private key) signs an RS256 JWT {sub: key_id, iat, jti} that is exchanged at /identity/public/v1/api/login for session cookies replayed on every call. Usage plans allow 1500 requests per 60 s per endpoint.
